notes_for_reviewer: ADR-009 specifies the wire format bit-for-bit; any future change to the encoded bytes MUST land as a new ADR AND bump encodingVersion, per CICLO_SPEC.md §16 Definition of Done item 6.

The encoder deliberately admits null, boolean, safe-integer number, bigint, string, Array, plain object, Set, and Map. It rejects everything else — Date, RegExp, Uint8Array, Buffer, typed arrays, promises, class instances, symbol keys, functions, cycles, and duplicate canonical entries in Set or Map — so callers must model state in this domain from the start.

Object keys are collected via Object.getOwnPropertyNames plus a getOwnPropertyDescriptor enumerability filter (Object.keys is forbidden by §13 lint), and Object.getOwnPropertySymbols is checked so that symbol-keyed properties raise SYMBOL_KEY rather than being silently dropped.
Length prefixes are fixed big-endian unsigned 32-bit integers so the encoding does not depend on platform endianness; big-endian is the transport-layer choice, encoded by explicit shifts.
Tests use Node 22's built-in TypeScript type stripping to import packages/core/src/index.ts directly from .mjs test files; no ts-node or bundler dependency is added.
Tests live under tests/core/ (mirroring the existing tests/{config,lint,boundary} layout) and the root `test` script glob was extended to include that directory.
payload.summary: Landed ADR-009 as a normative bit-for-bit specification of the canonical state encoder and implemented canonicalEncode plus CanonicalEncoderError in packages/core. Framing is: fixed magic 0x43454E43 + 1-byte frame version + big-endian u32-prefixed encodingVersion UTF-8 bytes + tagged root value. Ten single-byte type tags separate null, false, true, safe-integer number (ASCII decimal with explicit sign), bigint (same shape but distinct tag so 1 never collides with 1n), string (u32-be-length + UTF-8), Array (ordered), plain object (unordered, keys sorted lexicographically by UTF-8 bytes recursively), Set (unordered, elements sorted by canonical byte order with duplicate detection), and Map (ordered by insertion order with duplicate-key detection). Every string, bigint payload, and collection carries a u32 big-endian length or count so no two distinct states can collide via concatenation. Rejections use CanonicalEncoderError with typed codes: UNDEFINED_VALUE, NAN, POSITIVE_INFINITY, NEGATIVE_INFINITY, NEGATIVE_ZERO, NON_INTEGER_NUMBER, UNSAFE_INTEGER, CYCLE, SYMBOL_KEY, DUPLICATE_COLLECTION_ENTRY, INVALID_ENCODING_VERSION, LENGTH_OVERFLOW, and UNSUPPORTED_TYPE (Date, RegExp, Uint8Array, class instances, functions, symbols). Cycle detection uses a WeakSet of objects currently on the encoding stack, so shared references (DAGs) are permitted while any true cycle throws. 48 new focused unit tests exercise recursive key-order invariance, ordered vs unordered collection distinctions, version separation, bigint/number tag distinction, length-framing ambiguity cases, every rejection code, and DAG acceptance. Package packages/core now declares type=module to eliminate the type-stripping performance warning. No hash, RNG, ledger, world, application, adapters, or Electron code was introduced.
